choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: neither is named primary, and the abstract and introduction report both total-idea variation and image-level homogenization without prioritizing either. They are different outcomes, neither supports a participant-level standardized between-arm effect, and neither differs by repeated session, AI arm, or subgroup.
choices.locator: PDF p. 11, Section 5.1, second paragraph (quote); pp. 1-2, Abstract and Introduction; pp. 5-8, Sections 4.2-4.2.3 and Figure 5.
choices.quote: the AI condition initially produced a broader design space at the group level at total idea level. However, in contrast to this, the final directions selected for exploration at the image level demonstrated a homogenization effect.
